PreToolUse.description: Run the safety classifier before any local write/edit. Refuses (exit 2) when the target is outside the workspace root or the workspace is read-only.
Belt-and-suspenders gate for the invoice CSV export tool. The MCP tool runs the same intercept in-process; this hook short-circuits the call before it even reaches the server.
Belt-and-suspenders gate for the email draft tool. Refuses HIGH classifications (read-only workspace) ahead of the MCP server invocation.

_note: Hooks require the `office-layer` CLI on PATH. The `Write|Edit` matcher uses ${OFFICE_LAYER_DEFAULT_WORKSPACE}; if that env var is unset, the workspace argument becomes empty and the classifier degrades to operation-only risk (no read-only / outside-workspace escalation). Disable individual hooks by deleting them.
